name: Conquest Path
description: Build military strength, seize multiple systems, and establish the infrastructure to hold them.

objectives.title: Battle Ready
objectives.description: Reach a combined fleet and station strength of 5,000.

actions.text: The offensive has momentum. Consolidate the captured systems.

objectives.title: Optional: Research Depth
objectives.description: Complete at least three research topics.

objectives.title: Hold the Line
objectives.description: Operate at least three stations after establishing capital presence.

completionText: The team controls a defensible multi-system foothold backed by capital infrastructure.
failureText: The conquest stalled before a defensible foothold could be established.
